# Encrypted URI cleanup uses the saved display identity

The accepted OpenPGP header overlay saves lastEncryptedUri and lastEncryptedNeckoUri when it registers the displayed message and forgets those saved values during cleanup. The network identity is not recalculated from whatever message is currently selected. For this display lifecycle, balance each registration using the captured identity, especially when selection can change before cleanup. This is a scoped source pattern; concurrent displays and cleanup ordering were not reproduced. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: OpenPGP displayed-message ownership.
